profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bloomberg
profile.summary: Obtain application development and administration experience where I can leverage my background in system infrastructure, system administration, and web development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Futures & Options Team

- Coordinating with Data Analysts, Product Managers, and Enterprise Support analysts to design efficient systems that reduce manual workflow, migrate existing processes under the new Data Technologies Futures & Options team, and create new datastores and services that provide significant value to the business. 

- Design and owned Coverage Service- a service that ingests over 20 millions records weekly from upstream non-relational databases, enriches the data via API calls to client services, and stores the data in a relational database

- Developed service that maintains membership of Penny Equity options. Created ETL pipeline that populates a nonrelational database as the source of truth. Designed and implemented an algorithm that can determine the membership of a given financial security to the Penny Equity program. The workflow generates a CSV that was originally generated manually by data analysts on a daily basis.

- Designed and built "Enterprise Support" for Coverage Service. Using the relational database from Coverage SVC as the source of truth, I designed and implemented a proxy service that allowed Data Analysts and Enterprise Support Analysts to leverage the team's data to support customer requests
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Infrastructure · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Python (Programming Language) · Data Streaming

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Post-Checkout Engineering Team

- Led Engineering effort for pilot implementation of AWS Step Functions as a replacement for Capsule's checkout workflow - resulting in increased fault tolerance and horizontal scaling for our checkout operations
- Architected & implemented Product Catalog as a replacement and enhancement over existing inventory management systems. The Product Catalog is a Kotlin application that uses the Springboot framework to consume medication information from First Databank to ensure accurate information on all prescription and over-the-counter medications.
- Implemented new APIs to be integrated with the Receiving process for Capsule. Receiving is the process by which Capsule acquires new medications at the pharmacy/facility. These APIs ensure visibility for pharmacists and other stakeholders, as well as accurate inventory counts for medications.

positions.title: Software Eng
positions.description:
ECR-Public Team

- Led Us-East-1 Region Build for the Proxy service for ECR-Public
- Created infrastructure for ECR-Public's image replication system
- Implemented API to handle image manifest and manifest list storage during ECR-Public replication

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer.

- Responsible for automating the processes for producers and consumers to publish and ingest data from a data lake
- Created Configuration Management process for automated testing suites
- Built various backend endpoints and functionality for a web application that allows data consumers and data producers to request read/write access to datasets in Capital One's Data Lake
- Implemented Unit Testing for backend endpoints
- Implemented resilience functionality for production applications in scenarios involving dependency failures
- Created communication between a web application, leveraging a Django/MySQL API & Backend in the cloud, and an on-premise Oracle Database
- Created a Flask API to initialize the production and development of a "strangle" application to reduce technical debt and give the enterprise more control over development
- Optimized deployment infrastructure by creating/altering AWS Cloudformation templates to increase deployment by at least 50% and also reducing risk

positions.title: Challenge Counselor
positions.description:
- Assisted with Challenge programming logistics
- Acted as a resource and counselor for students
- Documented student behavior

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
- Migrated existing data from excel spreadsheets to non-relational databases, leveraging Python scripts and MongoDB
- Implementing a RESTful API using Flask on top of MongoDB
-  Establishing a Web interface to interact with RESTful API

positions.title: Summer Analyst
positions.description:
- Migrated the firm’s server requisition process to an automated Business Model Process
- Leveraged firm-specific technology, RESTful services, databases schemas, and validation logic
- Obtained and implemented logic of full stack development

positions.title: Legislative Aide
positions.description: - Shadowed Georgia State Rep. Rahn Mayo during the Georgia Legislative Session.

positions.title: Summer Analyst
positions.description:
- Developed diagnostic tool that automates the process for generating and collecting debugging information, and storing it in the central location for troubleshooting.
- Architect of modular framework, for future implementation of automated diagnostic analysis and automated remediation.
